text: Become the preferred digital channel for communication between the university and its students.
Increase student retention by making campus life easier to navigate.
Reduce the cost of delivering routine administrative services to the organization.
Strengthen the university's brand as an innovative institution in the education market.
Ensure the platform complies with the regulatory obligations that apply to the institution's stakeholders.
Support the long-term strategy of expanding flexible and remote learning offers.
Improve satisfaction of international students during their first semester.
Generate new revenue by opening the platform to local businesses.
Give management a clear overview of how the services are used across the organization.
Enable the university to compete with other institutions for prospective students.
Increase the adoption of sustainable transport among staff and students.
Provide a product that stakeholders consider trustworthy and reliable.
The app supports group study planning with shared calendars.
Provide a library module that allows students to reserve and renew books.
The platform includes a personalised dashboard for each student.
Enable integration with the learning management system.
Support multi-language content across the application.
Provide a feedback service for course evaluations.
The app offers a lost-and-found capability for campus items.
Allow students to manage their payment methods and fee history in one portal.
Include a workflow for approving extension requests.
Support accessibility features for visually impaired users.
Provide a notification centre for announcements.
Enable peer tutoring matching between students.
The system shall display the remaining library loan days on the book details screen.
When the user taps the Submit button, the system shall validate the feedback form fields.
The user can filter the event list by category.
The system shall send a confirmation message after an extension request is submitted.
The user shall be able to reset the password by clicking the link sent by email.
The system shall sort search results by relevance and show the first page of hits.
The user can upload a profile photo from the settings page.
The system shall display an error message if the student number entered is invalid.
The user can select a language from the drop-down list on the welcome screen.
The system shall calculate the outstanding fee total and show it on the payment screen.
The user can mark an announcement as read by swiping left.
The system shall show the tutor's availability when the user opens the tutor profile.
The search service shall return results in under 200 ms using an inverted index.
All API traffic shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3.
The database shall store passwords as bcrypt hashes with a cost factor of 12.
The image upload endpoint shall accept files up to 5 MB and store them in object storage.
The notification queue shall process at least 1000 messages per second.
The REST API shall return JSON responses with pagination of 50 records per page.
The cache layer shall evict entries after 10 minutes using an LRU policy.
The mobile client shall use a local SQLite table to persist drafts.
The payment adapter class shall call the gateway over HTTPS and retry failed requests twice.
The schema shall contain a foreign key from enrollments to courses with an index.
The service shall run on two replicas with CPU utilisation below 70%.
Session data shall be stored in Redis with a TTL of 30 minutes.
